segments.text: This synthetic narration was added afterward. The video is one continuous take of Replay Lab, which learns workflows and checks your progress.

This tutorial records our clearly labeled Code Lab simulation. Before this take, Meta Llama generated a proposal from the transcript and locally extracted screen text. The proposal was reviewed and simplified.
Here are the two prepared checkpoints and their dependency. The reviewed workflow requires explicit approval before guided verification. Model proposals alone cannot establish completion.

The tutorial expects Extensions Marketplace, but Settings is deliberately opened instead. Replay Lab captures the real shared tab. Local O C R reads its pixels, and Meta Llama reasons over that text. Waiting is shown at its actual speed.
FAIL. The visible Preferences heading contradicts the approved state. Replay Lab recommends returning to Extensions Marketplace.
The suggested correction is followed on the same shared tab. Extensions Marketplace is now visible. Replay Lab captures the updated screen and checks the same approved constraint again.
PASS. This checkpoint is verified. The search step unlocks and stays pending.
The next step requires search results for Replay Formatter. Instead, Explorer is shown. This screen does not establish the required state, and missing text alone cannot prove a specific mistake.
Replay Lab returns UNCERTAIN and keeps the checkpoint pending.

This separate evaluation executed twenty controlled local O C R cases. All expected verdicts matched, including ten uncertainty cases. These development measurements are not a benchmark of Meta model accuracy.
Meta Llama three point two runs locally. O C R reads pixels; Llama receives redacted text. Deterministic rules decide completion. One checkpoint is verified; the other remains pending.

disclosure: Synthetic narration added after the actual continuous recording. No video frames or inference timing are changed.
